personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center optimized for precise data streaming and terminal-like file management.

spacing.rule: Use tight, metric-driven spacing (sm/md). Ensure dense data is separated by hairlines (borders/dividers) rather than excess whitespace.

dont's: Skip glass completely for this developer utility app.
Rely on solid surfaceSecondary and thin borderStrong dividers for elevation.

screens.name: Transfer Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for configuring the data source and monitoring live streaming to the USB.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for URL inputs; disabling source toggles until ready.
states.empty: No source selected; 'Connect USB Drive' prominent prompt.
states.error: 'USB Drive Not Found' or 'Stream Interrupted' banner in red (#FF453A).

screens.layout: Use a segmented control for the source toggle (Internet vs Local). Below, place the URL input or media picker. Central to the screen is a 'Terminal Console' (surfaceSecondary card, JetBrains Mono font) showing live streaming metrics: bytes/s, total downloaded, compression status. Keep a sticky primary 'Start Stream' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: USB File Browser
screens.purpose: A dense file explorer for navigating and managing files currently on the external USB.

states.loading: Spinner in center while SAF indexes the USB directory.
states.empty: Empty state illustration (USB flash drive) with 'USB Drive is Empty'.
states.error: Error reading USB directory, retry button.

screens.layout: Header shows storage stats (used vs free) using a progress bar. List rows should be dense, featuring a file type icon, file name, and file size metadata. Tapping a file row routes to the Media Preview screen.

screens.name: Media Preview
screens.purpose: On-the-fly preview and playback screen for media streaming directly from USB.

states.loading: Centered circular progress representing buffer/decompression initialization.
states.error: Playback error banner with retry option.

screens.layout: Large media viewport filling the upper 2/3 of the screen. The bottom 1/3 contains playback controls and a high-contrast timeline scrubber slider for precise timestamp navigation. Background remains pure surface (#0E0E0F) to highlight the media.

hero_abstract_stream.alt: Abstract blue and purple data stream swirling against a black background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility personality: NO glassmorphism, use solid surfaceSecondary and thin border dividers.
Implement the live transfer console with JetBrains Mono for a terminal-like aesthetic. Numbers should align properly for metrics.
The source toggle should be a segmented control that instantly switches the input UI below it.
Ensure touch targets for file browser rows and media scrubber are at least 44x44pt.
Implement a gradient-to-dark scrim (top-to-bottom) if the abstract hero image is used behind any status text.
Do NOT use pure black-on-white. Text on surface uses #FFFFFF. Text on brand uses #000000.
Use Phosphor icons consistently in outlined or filled states (avoid mixing).
